title: A tundish drips continuously | G3 Cylinder Help
description: Understand a tundish drips continuously. Distinguish the symptom, gather useful details and arrange competent cylinder assessment in London.
answer: Continuous discharge needs assessment of pressure controls, valve condition and the complete safety arrangement; observe it without touching the water.

sections.heading: What this symptom can mean
paragraphs: The Megaflo Eco fault table distinguishes continual from intermittent discharge. A pressure-reducing fault or valve-seating problem can be relevant, but the visible symptom alone does not identify the component to replace.

sections.heading: Information to gather safely
paragraphs: Record whether discharge continues while normal heating is off. If water is very hot or steam is present, use the urgent safety guidance rather than treating it as routine dripping.

sections.heading: How the enquiry becomes an investigation
paragraphs: The cylinder make, full model and heating arrangement should be identified first. The same visible symptom can arise from different causes, and a relief device may be protecting the system rather than creating the original problem. Component testing and any repair belong to a person competent for the work.

sections.heading: Discuss the appropriate next step
paragraphs: Call 020 7205 4433 with the postcode, symptom history and any previous service findings. The enquiry establishes the proposed assessment and availability. Do not use this guide as a substitute for the actual appliance safety instructions or an on-site diagnosis.

faqs.question: Why is constant discharge different from dripping only during heating?
faqs.answer: Timing helps distinguish possible pressure, valve and expansion conditions, but a competent assessment is needed before selecting a repair.
